GAMEPLAY_LowWarning.French (France): Oxygène faible - Vous vous sentez faible
GAMEPLAY_LowWarning.Spanish (Spain): Bajo nivel de oxígeno - te sientes débil
GAMEPLAY_LowWarning.Turkish: Düşük oksijen seviyesi - Kendinizi halsiz hissedersiniz
GAMEPLAY_LowWarning.Russian: Низкий уровень кислорода - Вы чувствуете слабость

GAMEPLAY_CriticalWarning.English: Critical oxygen - You are seriously weakened
GAMEPLAY_CriticalWarning.French (France): Oxygène critique - Vous êtes sérieusement affaibli
GAMEPLAY_CriticalWarning.German: Kritischer Sauerstoffmangel – Du bist ernsthaft geschwächt
GAMEPLAY_CriticalWarning.Turkish: Kritik oksijen seviyesi - Ciddi derecede bitap düştün
GAMEPLAY_CriticalWarning.Russian: Критический уровень кислорода — вы серьезно ослаблены

GAMEPLAY_isAcclimatized.English: Your body has acclimatized to the altitude
GAMEPLAY_isAcclimatized.French (France): Votre corps s'est acclimaté à l'altitude
GAMEPLAY_isAcclimatized.Spanish (Spain): Tu cuerpo se ha aclimatado a la altitud
GAMEPLAY_isAcclimatized.German: Ihr Körper hat sich an die Höhe akklimatisiert

GAMEPLAY_isntAcclimatized.English: Your body is no longer acclimatized to the altitude
GAMEPLAY_isntAcclimatized.French (France): Votre corps n'est plus acclimaté à l'altitude
GAMEPLAY_isntAcclimatized.Spanish (Spain): Tu cuerpo ya no está aclimatado a la altitud
GAMEPLAY_isntAcclimatized.German: Ihr Körper ist nicht mehr an die Höhe akklimatisiert
GAMEPLAY_isntAcclimatized.Russian: Ваш организм больше не акклиматизирован к высоте

GAMEPLAY_AMSriskDescription.English: The lack of oxygen is starting to become a concern. You risk developing an AMS, descend as soon as possible.
GAMEPLAY_AMSriskDescription.French (France): Le manque d'oxygène commence à être préoccupant. Vous risquez de développer un MAM, descendez dès que possible.
GAMEPLAY_AMSriskDescription.Spanish (Spain): La falta de oxígeno empieza a ser preocupante. Corre el riesgo de desarrollar un MAM, así que descienda lo antes posible.
GAMEPLAY_AMSriskDescription.German: Der Sauerstoffmangel wird zunehmend besorgniserregend. Sie laufen Gefahr, an AH zu erkranken – steigen Sie so schnell wie möglich ab.
GAMEPLAY_AMSriskDescription.Turkish: Oksijen eksikliği endişe verici olmaya başladı. ADH geliştirme riski altındasınız; mümkün olan en kısa sürede alçalın.
GAMEPLAY_AMSriskDescription.Russian: Нехватка кислорода начинает вызывать беспокойство. Вы рискуете заработать ОГБ — спускайтесь как можно скорее.

GAMEPLAY_AMSDescription.English: The AMS has fully developed, your brain functions have severely deteriorated.
GAMEPLAY_AMSDescription.French (France): Le MAM s'est pleinement développé, vos fonctions cérébrales se sont gravement détériorées.
GAMEPLAY_AMSDescription.Spanish (Spain): El MAM se ha desarrollado completamente, sus funciones cerebrales se han deteriorado gravemente.
GAMEPLAY_AMSDescription.German: Die AH ist voll ausgeprägt, Ihre Gehirnfunktionen haben sich stark verschlechtert.
GAMEPLAY_AMSDescription.Turkish: ADH tamamen gelişti, beyin işlevleriniz ciddi şekilde bozuldu.
GAMEPLAY_AMSDescription.Russian: ОГБ полностью развилась, функции вашего мозга серьёзno ухудшились.

GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffCause.English: Prolonged exposure to critical oxygen levels
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffCause.French (France): Exposition prolongée à un niveau d'oxygène critique
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffCause.Spanish (Spain): Exposición prolongada a niveles críticos de oxígeno
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffCause.Turkish: Kritik oksijen seviyelerine uzun süre maruz kalma

GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffDescription.English: Your body is beginning to adapt to oxygen-poor environments. Altitude affects you less than before.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffDescription.French (France): Votre organisme commence à s'habituer aux environnements pauvres en oxygène. L'altitude vous affecte moins qu'auparavant.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffDescription.Spanish (Spain): Tu organismo empieza a acostumbrarse a los entornos pobres en oxígeno. La altitud te afecta menos que antes.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffDescription.German: Dein Körper beginnt, sich an sauerstoffarme Umgebungen zu gewöhnen. Die Höhe beeinträchtigt dich weniger als zuvor.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffDescription.Turkish: Vücudun oksijen bakımından fakir ortamlara alışmaya başlıyor. İrtifa seni eskisine göre daha az etkiliyor.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIBuffDescription.Russian: Ваш организм начинает привыкать к среде с низким содержанием кислорода. Высота влияет на вас меньше, чем раньше.

GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffCause.English: Prolonged exposure to insufficient oxygen levels
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffCause.French (France): Exposition prolongée à un niveau d'oxygène insuffisant
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffCause.Spanish (Spain): Exposición prolongada a niveles insuficientes de oxígeno
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffCause.Turkish: Yetersiz oksijen seviyelerine uzun süre maruz kalma

GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffDescription.English: Your body has deeply acclimatized to extreme altitudes. The effects of oxygen deprivation are significantly reduced.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffDescription.French (France): Votre organisme s'est profondément acclimaté aux très hautes altitudes. Les effets du manque d'oxygène sont nettement atténués.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffDescription.Spanish (Spain): Tu organismo se ha aclimatado profundamente a altitudes extremas. Los efectos de la falta de oxígeno se reducen de forma significativa.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffDescription.German: Dein Körper hat sich stark an extreme Höhen akklimatisiert. Die Auswirkungen des Sauerstoffmangels sind deutlich abgeschwächt.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffDescription.Turkish: Vücudun aşırı irtifalara derinlemesine uyum sağladı. Oksijen eksikliğinin etkileri belirgin şekilde azalır.
GAMEPLAY_AcclimatizedIIBuffDescription.Russian: Ваш организм глубоко акклиматизировался к экстремальным высотам. Последствия нехватки кислорода значительно ослаблены.
